why: A (universe 0) is Morse.curv_inner: for ANY real Lie algebra L and ad-invariant bilinear B, B (curv (halfLie L) X Y Z) W = ¼ B ⁅X,Y⁆ ⁅Z,W⁆ — pure algebra. B: on a Lie group with a bi-invariant metric and Levi-Civita connection, ⟨curvF X_u X_v X_w, X_z⟩ = ¼⟨[X_u,X_v],[X_w,X_z]⟩ at every point. B ⇒ A only vacuously. A ⇒ B fails: B needs (d) X ⊢ Y = ½[X,Y] and 21.3(a) on the group (V12_2, V12_3), geometric facts the project does not formalize for Lie groups. Bridge B_of_inputs (uses A, #rt_check OK): (d) + ad-invariance of the metric at 1 (B of V12_1 (6)) ⇒ B, via curvF on left-invariant fields = liv (curv (halfLie 𝔤) u v w), ⟨X_a,X_b⟩ ≡ ⟨a,b⟩ and A for 𝔤 with ipForm. A carries exactly the algebraic step of (c).
